mapper.sql: consent_type AS type,agreed,policy_version AS policyVersion, DATE_FORMAT(agreed_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS agreedAt,DATE_FORMAT(withdrawn_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS withdrawnAt, guardian_name AS guardianName,guardian_relation AS guardianRelation
mapper.select: SELECT FROM user_consents WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND consent_type=#{type}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_consents(user_id,consent_type,agreed,policy_version,agreed_at,withdrawn_at,guardian_name,guardian_relation) VALUES(#{userId},#{type},#{agreed},#{policyVersion}, CASE WHEN #{agreed} THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END,CASE WHEN #{agreed} THEN NULL ELSE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP END, #{guardianName},#{guardianRelation}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE agreed=VALUES(agreed),policy_version=VALUES(policy_version), agreed_at=CASE WHEN VALUES(agreed) THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE agreed_at END, withdrawn_at=CASE WHEN VALUES(agreed) THEN NULL ELSE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP END, guardian_name=COALESCE(VALUES(guardian_name),guardian_name),guardian_relation=COALESCE(VALUES(guardian_relation),guardian_relation)
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id AS userId,u.role,COALESCE(sp.age,u.age) AS age,sp.student_id AS studentId FROM users u LEFT JOIN student_profiles sp ON sp.user_id=u.user_id WHERE u.user_id=#{userId}
